facts.statement: The study is a systematic review that traces the technological development of micro-magnetic stimulation systems, covering the shift from early discrete inductors to modern MEMS-based coils, arrays, and wireless devices.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: Micro-magnetic stimulation is described as a method that offers high spatial precision and temporal resolution without requiring direct physical contact between electrodes and tissue.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The review compares different manufacturing approaches, such as standard MEMS and heterogeneous integration, and analyzes how the shape of the coils affects the focus and selectivity of the magnetic field.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The review discusses recent advances in frequency-division multiple access and autonomous power allocation techniques used for targeting multiple sites simultaneously.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: Future research directions mentioned include sub-millimeter-scale integration, co-optimization of power and signal, and intelligent closed-loop neural interfaces for large-scale neuromodulation systems.
facts.subject: other
